responsibility: Declares the derive expander specialized for builtin #[derive(Eq)]. It defines the DeriveEq visitor interface, including the entry point that returns the synthesized impl items, helpers for building the assert_receiver_is_total_eq method and temporary AssertParamIsEq type-check statements, and the shape-specific visit hooks used to generate Eq and structural-equality impls from supported Rust item definitions.
same_name_distinction: Header for the Eq derive expander: it declares DeriveEq, its result shape returning multiple impl items, and helper methods for Eq assertion generation, while rust-derive-eq.cc contains the concrete traversal and impl-building code.
